driver_1.total_error_method: equal weight mean of the per-event normalised costs

differentiable.rollout: Euler, one step per real time delta, leader = measured lv (constant tensor)
differentiable.graph: state (s, v) from the first measured sample, IDM written pointwise in torch
differentiable.parameterisation: z in R^5 -> theta = LOWER + sigmoid(z) * (UPPER - LOWER)
differentiable.starts: reference theta0 + seeded Latin hypercube (same strategy and seed as M2)
differentiable.batching: the 10 starts share one (n_starts, 5) tensor; loss = sum of per-start costs
differentiable.ranking: starts ranked by idm_core.total_error with RK4 (same yardstick as M1..M4)
differentiable.objective: idm_core.total_error as written in torch (equal weight mean of per-event costs)
